entries.text: Time passes in moments-- moments which rushing past... Define the path of a life... Just as surely as they lead towards its end. How rarely do we stop to examine that path-- to see the reasons why all things happen. To consider whether the path we take in life is our own making, or simply one into which we drift with eyes closed. But what if we could stop, pause to take stock... Of each precious moment before it passes? Might we then see the endless forks in the road that have shaped a life? And seeing those choices, choose another path?

entries.text: I spoke at length to Maggie. It's time... That you took responsibility for the hurt you caused in your family. It's no accident that you got sick, Daniel. You've been running from the truth for ten years.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Dana, it was only to be with you. You were all I lived for.
entries.speaker: Daniel Waterston

entries.text: Maybe the reason you're alive now is to make up for that-- to make it up to Maggie.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: That's Maggie talking, not you.
entries.speaker: Daniel Waterston

entries.text: No. I'm not the same person, Daniel. I wouldn't have known that if I hadn't seen you again. Excuse me!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Hey.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I was just looking for you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: But you're supposed to be in England.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'm back.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What happened?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Nothing. There was no event, no crop circles. Big waste of time. [ sighs ]
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Maybe sometimes nothing happens for a reason, Mulder.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What is that supposed to mean?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Nothing. Come on. I'll make you some tea.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I just find it hard to believe.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What part?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The part where I go away for two days, your whole life changes.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I didn't say my whole life changed.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You speaking to god in a buddhist temple. God speaking back?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Now, I didn't say that god spoke back. I said that I had some kind of a vision.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Well, for you that's like saying you're having david crosby's baby. What is it?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I once considered spending my whole life with this man. What I would have missed.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I don't think you can know. I mean, how many different lives would we be leading if we made different choices? We-- we don't know.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What if there was only one choice... And all the other ones were wrong... And there were signs along the way to pay attention to?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Then all the... Choices... Would then lead to this very moment. One wrong turn and... We wouldn't be sitting here together. Now, that says a lot. It says a lot, a lot, a lot. I mean, it's probably more than we should be getting into at this late hour.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
